children: rose 7.2% in German trading after a report that BASF (
) approached its German chemical rival about a takeover. BASF fell 2.5%.
recently made a proposal to Evonik (EKVIY) and its largest holders, the RAG-Stiftung foundation, according to a Financial Times report  on Friday, which cited people familiar with the matter.
has been talking to advisers about a potential offer for Evonik

since earlier this year and is continuing to work a possible deal, according to the FT report. The position of RAG-Stiftung, which has a 44% stake in Evonik, will be key to whether any transaction can happen.
BASF, Evonik, and the RAG-Stiftung declined to comment to the FT.
Reuters, citing a person familiar with the matter, reported on Friday that Evonik is not aware of a takeover approach from BASF.
The FT item comes after Dealreporter on Monday
explored a potential deal with Evonik
this year. One source downplayed the possibility of a deal as BASF is “cash constrained” and will get the Agricultural Solutions IPO completed before it does an acquisition.

title: Evonik gains after report of BASF takeover approach
